summary.text: Steve Eliason is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 43, where he has served since 2011, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a financial manager and a resident of Sandy, with University of Utah degrees in accounting and business administration.

paragraphs.text: Steven Eliason was born in and lives in Sandy, Utah, and graduated from Granger High School.
He earned a B.S. in accounting and an M.B.A. from the University of Utah, and his career includes working as a financial manager for the University of Utah hospital and clinics.
He has also volunteered as a scoutmaster for the Boy Scouts of America.
Eliason has been a member of the Utah House of Representatives since 2011.
In the 2023-2024 session he served on the Health and Human Services Committee and chaired the Revenue and Taxation Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
